title: ONCE Message Envelope
description: Initial transport envelope draft. The payload is opaque ciphertext; this schema does not define cryptography or a complete wire protocol.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier generated by the sender.

sender.description: ONCE identifier or protocol-defined sender reference.

content_type.description: Content type inside the encrypted payload; avoid sensitive plaintext metadata.

profile.description: Identifier of a separately specified, reviewed E2EE profile.

payload.description: Opaque encrypted payload. Plaintext must not be submitted in this field.

signature.description: Signature format and key binding are defined by the selected cryptographic profile.
